thingsToDo.title: Shala River Day Trip
thingsToDo.description: Known as the 'Thailand of Albania', the Shala River features crystal clear water tucked between steep mountain peaks. The day trip includes the scenic boat ride from Komani and we'll help you organize the departure right from the hostel.
thingsToDo.alt: Crystal clear water at the Shala River in Northern Albania

thingsToDo.title: Theth & Valbona Treks
thingsToDo.description: Explore the heart of the Albanian Alps on the famous Theth-to-Valbona hike. We'll help organize your transport and securely store your main luggage for free while you trek through the majestic northern peaks.
thingsToDo.alt: Hiking in the Albanian Alps near Theth and Valbona

thingsToDo.title: Rozafa Castle
thingsToDo.description: The city's top attraction. Perched on a rocky hill with beautiful views across Lake Shkodër and three rivers. Best visited an hour before sunset for the golden lighting across the valleys.
thingsToDo.alt: View from Rozafa Castle in Shkoder

thingsToDo.title: The Pedestrian Street (Kolë Idromeno)
thingsToDo.description: The lively Venetian-style pedestrian street starting right outside the hostel! Lined with independent cafes, shops, and restaurants, it's perfect for evening promenades.
thingsToDo.alt: Walking down the Pedonale in Shkoder

thingsToDo.title: Lake Shkodër & Shiroka Village
thingsToDo.description: The largest lake in the Balkans is a breathtaking natural wonder where dramatic karst mountains meet fields of floating water lilies. It's also a world-renowned sanctuary for over 280 bird species.
thingsToDo.alt: Biking along Lake Shkoder towards Shiroka

thingsToDo.title: Mesi Bridge (The Old Bridge)
thingsToDo.description: A stunning, curved Ottoman bridge resting over the shallow, opal waters of the Kir River, built in 1768 to connect the city with the northern highlands. Also a great spot for a swim!
thingsToDo.alt: The historic Ottoman Mesi Bridge in Shkoder

thingsToDo.title: Marubi National Photography Museum
thingsToDo.description: A quiet, modern exhibition featuring over 150 years of Albanian history through the incredibly detailed lenses of the Marubi family. Just a few doors down from the hostel!
thingsToDo.alt: Inside the Marubi National Photography Museum
